resolved.name: rung1_preregistration
resolved.status: PRE-REGISTERED. Signed off by the user on 2026-10-12 (METHODOLOGY 'RULINGS (user, 2026-10-12)', item 2: evo -a SE(3) primary; XUKO as the UKF record; cross-track drift per minute and heading drift in deg/min added as secondary metrics BEFORE ANY DATA). Copied from docs/rung1_preregistration_draft.json; changed: this field, the name, the rationale entries 'secondary' and 'ukf_record_implementation', and the new REQUIRED section 'secondary'. Read by eval/real_score.py (load_prereg, strict). Any later change is a dated amendment made before the affected data are scored.

rationale.window: docs/rung1_preregistration.md sec. 4.2: from MOCAP height only; take-off + 25 s (EKF3's flow-aiding start, ~16 s after take-off in SITL, plus margin) to landing - 5 s (the flare). Ground level = 5th percentile of the whole mocap record (the record may start with the vehicle held up for the sync wiggle).
rationale.primary_metric: evo_ape_a_se3: the simulation's STANDING metric (evo -a, Umeyama SE(3), no scale, three_way_eval's exact call). The sim-to-real statement (sec. 7) compares DECISION CATEGORIES with the simulation's, which were all decided on evo -a; a different primary metric would compare categories decided on different metrics. ate_4dof (yaw + translation) is reported as SECONDARY: it is the physically tighter fit for gravity-aligned frames, and on SITL the two agree to 1 mm (handover 2026-10-10_r1_mocap_align_scorer).
rationale.ukf_record: XUKO: the UKF port's CURRENT-TIME output (AP_NavUKF.cpp log_state, stamped AP_HAL::micros64()), the like-for-like counterpart of XKF1, which logs EKF3's output-predictor state (AP_NavEKF3_Logging.cpp:26-27 getVelNED/getPosNE -> AP_NavEKF3_Outputs.cpp:257-263 outputDataNew). XUKF is the fused state at the delayed fusion horizon; it is reported as a secondary row only.
rationale.ukf_record_implementation: FLAGGED 2026-10-12 (handover docs/handovers/2026-10-12_r1_scoring_items.md, section C), the record is unchanged: the fork's Replay of a stock-flown log writes XUKO WITHOUT its FMT record (checked on stored Replay outputs), so XUKO is not decodable from the Replay output log, and pymavlink cannot read such a log at all. The scorer reads logs with eval/df_reader.py and refuses XUKO when its FMT is absent. Until the port is fixed, the XUKO values are taken from the port's current-time CSV with XUKO's exact columns (--est-csv; port spec in the handover); which of the two sources is used is a USER RULING, recorded before scoring.
rationale.drift: motion_onset_path: the 4-DoF start alignment uses the first init_path_m of mocap horizontal travel after the motion onset (speed > 0.15 m/s for 1 s), i.e. the start of the first leg. Fixes draft defect 1: the old [t_to + 25 s, t_to + 30 s] lay inside the 30 s hover, where the fitted yaw is noise. init_path_m (2.0 m) must not exceed the first leg length [TBD-S]; it is confirmed when the leg length is fixed, before any result flight.
rationale.clock_map: Fixes draft defect 2: the mocap -> FC clock map is fitted on the two DISARMED sync wiggles, found by mocap_align's default rule (the last |w| burst > 2 rad/s before arming and the first after disarming, +-2 s; flight cards D6/D8). The scorer refuses a flight whose mocap_align JSON used non-default early/late windows or a different rule.
rationale.secondary: Ruled 2026-10-12 BEFORE ANY DATA, for comparability with the simulation corridor results; docs/rung1_preregistration.md sec. 4.4. heading_drift: the corridor rule (eval/d15_drift.py, phase4_eval, d15_port_score): yaw error = estimator heading - mocap heading, unwrapped, wrapped to +-180 unless it runs away (>= wrap_limit_deg), least-squares slope in deg/min over the window W, NED sense (clockwise positive); offset-invariant, so unaligned by construction. cross_track_drift: the lateral (right-normal of the mocap horizontal velocity) position-error growth, integrated over the cruise samples in W (mocap smoothed speed > min_speed_mps), divided by the cruise minutes; the estimator frame is rotated into the mocap frame by ONE yaw taken at take-off (the circular mean of the heading difference over the anchor_avg_s s ending at mocap take-off), no fit. On a straight northward path it equals the corridor's position-error growth across the corridor (SITL regression eval/results/r1_scorer/regression_secondary_2026-10-12.json).

resolved.notes: max_mocap_interp_gap_s 0.05 assumes mocap >= 100 Hz (the R7 requirement); it is confirmed once the mocap rate is known [TBD-S]. min_speed_mps (0.15, = onset_speed_mps) must lie below the leg speed (0.3-0.5 m/s) [TBD-S, confirmed with the profile]. PRIMARY rows: EKF3 (XKF1@100: the REPLAYED core 0; an ArduPilot Replay output log carries the original onboard records with C = 0, 1, ... and the replayed ones with C = 100 + core, as Tools/Replay/check_replay.py pairs them; the scorer refuses a log whose XKF1@100 TimeUS sequence differs from XKF1@0's), UKF (XUKO; see rationale.ukf_record_implementation), FGO (converter TUM). SECONDARY rows: UKF_horizon (XUKF) and EKF3_onboard (XKF1@0, the flight's own onboard core 0), all from the same Replay output log. Stock rung-1 firmware runs no UKF onboard, so every XUKO/XUKF record in that log comes from the fork's Replay.
